items.name: shadcn-hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: A large heading at the top of a page, with text, buttons and a picture.

items.name: shadcn-cards
items.title: Cards
items.description: A grid of cards, each with a picture, a heading, text and a link.

items.name: shadcn-call-to-action
items.title: Call to action
items.description: A highlighted box asking visitors to do something, with a button.

items.name: shadcn-testimonials
items.title: Testimonials
items.description: Quotes from people, with their names and photos.

items.name: shadcn-pricing
items.title: Pricing table
items.description: Plans side by side, with prices, what each includes and a button.

items.name: shadcn-notice
items.title: Notice
items.description: A short message that stands out, such as a closure or a change of times.

items.name: feed-list
items.title: News feed
items.description: The latest items of another site's RSS or Atom feed, read when the site is built: titles linking to them, with optional dates.

items.name: map
items.title: Map
items.description: A Google map of an address or place, or one from Google Maps' embed code. No API key needed.

items.name: social-links
items.title: Social links
items.description: Links to social networks, each shown as the network's mark in the text's color.

items.name: panel
items.title: Panel
items.description: A box with its title in a colored bar, other blocks inside it, and an optional button at its foot.

items.name: slideshow-hero
items.title: Slideshow with quick links
items.description: Full-width pictures that fade from one to the next, with a badge and a column of quick links over them.

items.name: section-links
items.title: Content with section links
items.description: A page's blocks with a sidebar of links to the other pages in its part of the menu.

items.name: custom-html
items.title: Custom HTML
items.description: HTML written by hand, such as a widget's embed code. Made safe unless you choose to use it exactly as written.

items.name: shadcn-faq
items.title: FAQ
items.description: Questions that open to show their answers.

items.name: shadcn-tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Content split into tabs, one shown at a time.

items.name: shadcn-carousel
items.title: Image carousel
items.description: Pictures shown one at a time, with buttons to move between them.
